row.evidence: Ramp's pricing comparison ticks 'Secure logins with SCIM, SSO, and SAML' for Free, Plus and Enterprise, and the help centre says Ramp supports SCIM integrations with Okta, Microsoft Entra and Rippling.
row.notes: Status unchanged (free). SCIM and SAML are on every plan including Free ($0/mo/user, unlimited users). Team plan is now Plus ($15/mo/user plus a platform fee based on team size; the card says annual billing saves 20% but shows no annual figure), so per-user SCIM price is left null because SCIM costs nothing extra on any tier. June recorded Free as the team plan; Free is free so Plus is used per the paid-team-tier rule. SCIM deprovisioning deactivates (cards suspended, data kept); it never deletes non-draft users, with optional auto-termination after 45 days. Entra uses a custom non-gallery app; Google, OneLogin and JumpCloud are SAML only. The Developer API (OAuth 2.0, users:read/users:write) covers list, create (deferred), update, deactivate and reactivate users, plus an audit-log events endpoint; no plan gate stated.

auth.token_source: Ramp dashboard: Company > Integrations > Okta/Microsoft Entra setup wizard (provided URL and API token)
auth.notes: Docs say 'API token'; bearer scheme inferred from Okta/Entra SCIM token fields, expiry not documented.

operations.notes: Updates are documented (Name, Department, Location, Manager, role); the HTTP verb Ramp accepts is not documented, so update_put/update_patch are null. Draft users are deleted on deprovision; non-draft users are only deactivated.

deprovision.data_retained: Account kept; cards and funds suspended, not terminated; user stays in workflows and approval chains. Optional auto-termination after a configurable wait (default 45 days, 0-365).

custom.how: Custom user fields mapped via urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:ramp:2.0:User attributes, then linked in Ramp SCIM settings > Custom field mappings

attributes.notes: Attribute list taken from the Okta and Entra mapping tables. Group attribute names are not documented; group push/assignment creates groups and memberships.

roles.how: Okta: roles.^[type=='rampUserRole'].value enum (BUSINESS_OWNER, BUSINESS_ADMIN, BUSINESS_USER, BUSINESS_BOOKKEEPER, GUEST_USER, IT_ADMIN) or Ramp Role ID 'roles' string array (Early Access, Custom Roles need Plus). Default: Manager role from manager assignment.

limitations.text: Cannot run SCIM and an HRIS integration at the same time.
SCIM never deletes non-draft users; termination is manual or via the optional auto-termination setting.
Role assignment from Okta only for businesses with the full Ramp suite including card issuing.
Sync latency: about 5-10 minutes for Okta, up to 40 minutes for Entra.
Entra group-based assignment needs Entra ID P1 or P2.

scim.notes: Pricing compare table ticks 'Secure logins with SCIM, SSO, and SAML' on Free, Plus and Enterprise. Help centre says SCIM is separate from SSO. Base URL and token are shown in the Ramp dashboard (not published). Supported IdPs named: Okta, Microsoft Entra, Rippling.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 client credentials (10-day tokens) or authorization code.

endpoints.purpose: List users (filter by role, status, department_id, location_id, entity_id, email, employee_id)
Update a user (role, department, location, manager, scheduled deactivation)
Manage a user's invite lifecycle (schedule, etc.)

endpoints.notes: Method not shown in llms-api.txt; GET inferred from the 'List' title.
Method not shown in llms-api.txt; GET inferred from the 'Get' title.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit log is listed as a Plus feature; the API docs do not state a plan gate.

rate_limits.text: 200 requests per 10-second rolling window, per source IP; 60-second request timeout.

user_api.notes: No plan gate stated on the help-centre API overview or the pricing page; admin access is required to create a developer app.

okta.notes: Ramp's guide says to install the Ramp app in Okta with preconfigured SCIM attributes. The OIN listing page for Ramp could not be located (okta.com/integrations/ramp/ is a different product, Tessitura RAMP).

entra.notes: Ramp's Entra SCIM guide uses a custom (non-gallery) application with Ramp's URL and token; no Microsoft Learn tutorial found (ramp-tutorial and ramp-provisioning-tutorial return 404).

google.notes: Google Workspace SAML via 'Other identity provider' custom SAML app; Google SCIM not among supported SCIM IdPs. 'Sign in with Google' is social login.

onelogin.notes: Ramp offers a guided OneLogin SAML setup; OneLogin is not in Ramp's list of SCIM IdPs. OneLogin catalogue not checked (blocks bots).

jumpcloud.notes: Ramp offers a guided JumpCloud SAML setup; JumpCloud is not in Ramp's list of SCIM IdPs. jumpcloud.com/support/integrate-with-ramp returned 403.

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS integrations (continuous HRIS sync; Workday on Plus/Enterprise); Rippling SCIM
fallbacks.notes: SAML domains require an existing active Ramp user; no JIT creation documented.

plans.name: Plus
